title: campus-half landing floor hardcodes the x10 ask instead of deriving it like EXPECTED
evidence:
testing.expectf(t, campus_window_spawns >= 10*WINDOW*95/100,
		"the campus half must land: in-window campus spawns %d < %d (10/tick × WINDOW × 0.95)", campus_window_spawns, 10*WINDOW*95/100)
detail: N5 derives the total EXPECTED (`stream_entries * surge.multiplier * WINDOW`) so a re-tune cannot silently drift it, but the campus sub-floor literal `10` (campus vol 1 x multiplier 10) stays hardcoded; changing campus volume or the multiplier would silently weaken the floor while EXPECTED updates.
recommended_fix: Derive the campus ask from the campus entry's volume times surge.multiplier times WINDOW (mirror N5), then floor = campus_ask*95/100.

title: usage() error string omits the new fold-check subcommand
evidence: fmt.eprintln("usage: harness run|save [demo...] [--stats-out <path>] | replay <demo> <log.bin> | drift-check | preview-check | stats-check <demo> | input-parity [save] | palcheck | map-preview <seed> [out.png]")
detail: The r3 fold registers fold-check but the usage() string does not list it (the header doc comment does). A mis-typed `fold-check` invocation prints a usage line missing the command, though exit code 2 is correct.
recommended_fix: Append `| fold-check <prev-hash> <prev-tick1>` to the usage() string.
